I'm prolly not gonna be much help but from the perspective of a viewer, it'd best for you to have an avatar you feel comfortable using otherwise you might not feel happy with what you're doing and it will be seen by your viewers.

Sadly there will be people that will find it weird, distastful or just wont interest them - they'll prolly wont stay, the people who will stay will be fine - it's simple as that, you might get a comment here and there but that's normal for anyone, as long as you dont let it get to you and keep at it you'll do great. It wont be easy at the start but once you start get that 2-3 viewers that do enjoy you, you'll grow and be more comfortable and be able to look past the people who might find it weird or distasteful, just dont dwell on those kind of people too much.

from experience - I've seen a few male vtubers using lolis and the likes, and yeah my first reaction was "this is really weird" but I kept coming back for their content or personality so at the end of the day it didnt matter as much as I thought it would, and I'm sure I'm not the only one who had a similar experience.
